policy: Preserve the historical golden set and its results. New IDs x001-x010 form outliers-v1; retire source-specific legacy cases where the selected source/data changed, and do not imply score equivalence.

legacy_cases.rationale: No-PMCID/restricted source removed by the cardiology task; keep its dependent cases under that task's migration decision.

The old FDA/donanemab unanswerable case is source- and time-specific; no new case reuses its label.

The new case checks a specific cited human diversity observation, not the former list of three intervention types.
The new false-premise case tests evidence for comparative AI-care outcomes, not the former broad limitations synthesis.

The Galápagos paper fails the new licence policy; its specific isolate prevalence is not reproduced by the replacement studies.
The new international WWTP result is a different study and endpoint, not an equivalent effluent-compliance result.
The old absent cholera case is not equivalent to the new absence of downstream patient infections linked to WWTP ARG measurements.
